audit_method.source_semantics_checked: The frozen train_rnn.py maps campaign-split vfold evaluation groups to the fold exclusion, places the remaining valid groups in the train+valid fitting pool, uses valid-seqs only to cap eval-source rows, and enforces fixed checkpoint/no-eval mode with campaign splits. The predictor argv wrapper puts the packet source_v6/scripts first on sys.path and passes that exact train_rnn.py, while WNN_PROJECT_ROOT points at the data/artifact root.

limits: This review does not admit work, predict a score, or claim unseen-fold/generalization evidence. The reviewer did not load or rehash large caches/parquet.

recipe_findings.checkpoint_selection: fixed zero-based endpoint: ep2 for 3-epoch arms, ep3 for 4-epoch arms; exporter binds the same run/epoch and writes full 1,873-row valid predictions. Grader must subset to the fold manifest evaluation.valid rows.
recipe_findings.exposure: The packet explicitly records folds2/3 were previously inspected. These are crossfold confirmation, not fresh global holdouts. A fold's eval groups may be in the other fold's training set; do not treat the two folds as independent seeds.

membership.fold2: 10,535 train +1,430 valid fit rows; 443 valid eval rows, 144 eval components; recomputed fit/eval component overlap0.
membership.fold3: 10,539 train +1,368 valid fit rows; 505 valid eval rows, 145 eval components; recomputed fit/eval component overlap0.

recipe_findings.prop_power_zero: The fold-specific propensity checkpoint and caches are bound and loaded, but p^0 is constant for positive p; this is the declared prop0 arm, not evidence of a learned propensity weighting effect.
recipe_findings.shared_fit: scratch h256 two-layer GRU; Muon all; batch32/chunk1000; wMSE with chunk normalization; LR0.001/WD0.01/onecycle; fp16; fold-specific own propensity model at power0; seed3; no initializer, teacher, resume or fit-time evaluation.
